title: Atmospheric pollution caused by space junk could be a huge problem

mock_data.title: Atmospheric pollution caused by space junk could be a huge problem
mock_data.passage:
After a Falcon 9 rocket stage burned up in the atmosphere, vaporised lithium and other metals drifted over Europe. This growing type of pollution could destroy ozone and form climate-warming clouds.

A SpaceX rocket that burned up after re-entering the atmosphere unleashed a plume of vaporised metals over Europe, a type of pollution that is expected to increase as spacecraft and satellites multiply.

The upper stage of a Falcon 9, which is designed to splash down in the Pacific Ocean for possible re-use, lost control due to engine failure and fell from orbit over the north Atlantic in February 2025.

People across Europe saw fiery debris streaking through the sky, some of which crashed behind a warehouse in Poland. Seeing the news, Robin Wing at the Leibniz Institute of Atmospheric Physics in Germany and his colleagues turned on their lidar, an instrument for atmospheric sensing. Twenty hours later, it detected a 10-fold spike in lithium, a key component of rocket hulls, in the upper atmosphere as the plume of vaporised metal drifted over it.

Atmospheric modelling suggested this plume had drifted 1600 kilometres from the area where the Falcon 9 re-entered the atmosphere. The study is the first to trace high-altitude pollution to a specific spacecraft re-entry.

The tiny metal particles "could be catalysing ozone destruction, creating clouds in the stratosphere and mesosphere, affecting the way that sunlight travels through the atmosphere", says Wing. "But all of this is understudied."

Worries about this type of pollution are growing as commercial space launches skyrocket and companies expand their mega-constellations of satellites, like SpaceX's Starlink and Amazon's Leo. About 14,500 satellites are already in orbit, and last month SpaceX applied to launch 1 million more for Elon Musk's goal of creating orbital data centres to power artificial intelligence.

To avoid a runaway cycle of collisions producing ever more space debris, satellites are typically allowed to fall and burn up at the end of their lifespan. Experts say the amount of space trash particles could grow by 50 times in the next decade and exceed 40 per cent of the mass that meteoroids currently bring into the atmosphere.

There is a misconception that space debris burns up in the atmosphere and disappears, says Daniel Cziczo at Purdue University, Indiana, who wasn't involved in the study. "Let's tap the brakes here, and let's really do some thorough analysis of what effect this material could have."

The Falcon 9 plume contained an estimated 30 kilograms of lithium. But given the composition of the alloys in rocket hulls, it would have contained a far greater amount of aluminium.

Vaporised aluminium reacts with atmospheric oxygen to form particles of aluminium oxide, which provide a surface where chlorine compounds can more easily break down. The chlorine radicals freed by this process react with and destroy ozone molecules in the stratosphere.

Researchers estimate that spacecraft burn-up is releasing 1000 tonnes of aluminium oxide into the atmosphere each year and growing. This threatens to expand the southern hemisphere's ozone hole, which has been shrinking as countries phase out ozone-depleting refrigerant gases. The loss of ozone could allow in more of the sun's ultraviolet rays, which cause skin cancer.

"In terms of metals, we're sort of moving into this new paradigm where the upper atmosphere is increasingly more influenced by anthropogenic pollution than natural sources," says Eloise Marais at University College London. "Space debris is starting to undo the progress with the ozone hole."

The metal oxide particles can also serve as nuclei upon which water vapour can condense into droplets, forming cirrus clouds in the upper troposphere, which tend to trap heat.

Scientists have measured particles from burned-up spacecraft in cirrus clouds. If they are encouraging cirrus cloud formation, it could worsen global warming, although this impact would still be small compared with that of greenhouse gases like carbon dioxide.

“There is a lot of scientific evidence that this material could be having deleterious effects on our atmosphere, and now it’s on us as scientists to figure out if those effects are taking place and how bad are they,” says Cziczo.

There may be solutions, such as building satellites out of materials like wood — although that could still release black carbon soot upon re-entry — or retiring more of them to high-altitude “graveyard orbits”.

“We need to take a little bit of time and think about what we’re doing before we do it,” says Wing. “This explosion of satellites… it’s very fast, and we don’t know the consequences.”

mock_data.translation:
Falcon 9 raketasi bosqichi atmosferada yonib ketganidan so'ng, bug'langan litiy va boshqa metallar Yevropa bo'ylab tarqalib ketdi (suzib yurdi). O'sib borayotgan ushbu turdagi ifloslanish ozon qatlamini yo'q qilishi va iqlimni isituvchi bulutlarni hosil qilishi mumkin.

Atmosferaga qayta kirgach yonib ketgan SpaceX raketasi Yevropa bo'ylab bug'langan metallar buluti (tutuni)ni chiqarib yubordi, bu kosmik kemalar va sun'iy yo'ldoshlar ko'payishi bilan ortishi kutilayotgan ifloslanish turidir.

Ehtimoliy qayta foydalanish uchun Tinch okeaniga tushishiga (qo'nishiga) mo'ljallangan Falcon 9 ning yuqori bosqichi dvigateldagi nosozlik tufayli boshqaruvni yo'qotdi va 2025-yil fevral oyida shimoliy Atlantika ustidan orbitadan quladi.

Butun Yevropa bo'ylab odamlar osmon bo'ylab chizib o'tayotgan(uchib o'tayotgan) olovli qoldiqlarni ko'rishdi, ulardan ba'zilari Polshadagi omborxona orqasida qulab tushdi. Yangiliklarni ko'rgach, Germaniyadagi Leybnis Atmosfera fizikasi institutidan Robin Ving va uning hamkasblari atmosferani sezish (o'lchash) uchun asbob bo'lgan lidarlarini yoqdilar. Yigirma soat o'tgach, bug'langan metall buluti uning ustidan o'tayotganda, yuqori atmosferada raketa korpuslarining asosiy komponenti bo'lgan litiyning 10 barobar keskin o'sishini(sakrashini) aniqladi.

Atmosfera modellashtirishi shuni ko'rsatdiki, ushbu tutun Falcon 9 atmosferaga qayta kirgan hududdan 1600 kilometr uzoqlikka tarqalgan. Ushbu tadqiqot yuqori balandlikdagi ifloslanishni aniq bir kosmik kemaning qayta kirishiga bog'lab o'rganga birinchi tadqiqotdir.

Kichik metall zarralari "ozonning yo'q qilinishini kuchaytirayotgan, stratosfera va mezosferada bulutlarni hosil qilib, quyosh nurining atmosfera orqali o'tishiga ta'sir qilayotgan bo'lishi mumkin", deydi Ving. "Ammo bularning barchasi yetarlicha o'rganilmagan."

Tijoriy kosmik parvozlar keskin o'sishi(osmonga sapchishi) va kompaniyalar SpaceX’ning Starlink va Amazon’ning Leo kabi o'zlarining sun'iy yo'ldosh mega-yulduz turkumlari (to'plamlari)ni kengaytirishi natijasida bu turdagi ifloslanish haqidagi xavotirlar ortib bormoqda. Taxminan 14,500 ta sun'iy yo'ldosh allaqachon orbitada bo'lib, o'tgan oy SpaceX sun'iy intellektni quvvatlantirish uchun orbital ma'lumotlar markazlarini yaratish bo'yicha Ilon Maskning maqsadi uchun yana 1 milliontasini uchirish uchun ariza berdi.

Borgan sari ko'proq kosmik chiqindilar hosil qiluvchi to'qnashuvlarning nazorat qilib bo'lmaydigan siklidan qochish uchun sun'iy yo'ldoshlarga odatda ishlash muddati tugagandan so'ng qulab tushish va yonib ketishga ruxsat beriladi. Mutaxassislarning fikriga ko'ra, kosmik axlat zarralari miqdori kelgusi o'n yillikda 50 baravarga ko'payishi va hozirda meteoroidlar atmosferaga olib kiradigan massaning 40 foizidan oshib ketishi mumkin.

Koinot qoldiqlari atmosferada yonib ketadi va yo'qoladi degan noto'g'ri tushuncha mavjud, deydi ushbu tadqiqotda ishtirok etmagan Indiana shtati Perdyu universiteti xodimi Daniel Cziczo. "Keling, bu yerda tormozni bosaylik va ushbu material qanday ta'sir ko'rsatishi ustida jiddiy tahlillar o'tkazaylik."

Falcon 9 tutunida taxminan 30 kilogramm litiy bo'lgan. Ammo raketa korpuslaridagi qotishmalarning tarkibini hisobga oladigan bo'lsak, unda alyuminiy miqdori ancha ko'proq bo'lgan edi.

Bug'langan alyuminiy atmosfera kislorodi bilan reaksiyaga kirishib, xlor birikmalari osonroq parchalanishi uchun sirtni ta'minlaydigan alyuminiy oksidi zarralarini hosil qiladi. Ushbu jarayon orqali ajralib chiqadigan xlor radikallari stratosferadagi ozon molekulalari bilan reaksiyaga kirishadi va ularni yo'q qiladi.

Tadqiqotchilar kosmik kemalarning yonishi har yili atmosferaga 1000 tonna alyuminiy oksidini chiqarayotganini va bu o'sib borayotganini ta'kidlashmoqda. Bu janubiy yarim sharning ozon teshigini kengaytirish xavfini tug'diradi, ayni paytda mamlakatlar ozonni yemiruvchi sovutgich gazlardan bosqichma-bosqich voz kechishi sabab kichrayib bordi. Ozonning yo'qolishi quyoshning teri saratoniga sabab bo'ladigan ultrabinafsha nurlarining ko'proq kirib kelishiga olib kelishi mumkin.

"Metallar nuqtai nazaridan, biz yuqori atmosfera tobora ko'lamda tabiiy manbalardan ko'ra antropogen (inson yaratgan) ifloslanish ta'siriga uchraydigan yangi paradigmaga(namunaga/qolipga) o'tmoqdamiz," deydi London Universitet kollejidan Eloiza Mare. "Koinot qoldiqlari ozon tuynugi bilan bog'liq yutuqlarni bekor qila(yo'qqa chiqara) boshladi."

Metall oksidi zarralari kondensatsiyalanishi(yig'ilishi/quyuqlashishi) uchun yadro bo'lib xizmat qilishi mumkin, bu esa yuqori troposferada issiqlikni ushlab qolishga moyil bo'lgan patsimon (cirrus) bulutlarni hosil qiladi.

Olimlar yonib ketgan kosmik kemalarning zarralarini patsimon bulutlarda o'lchashdi. Agar ular patsimon bulutlarning paydo bo'lishiga turtki bo'lsa, bu global isishni yomonlashtirishi mumkin, garchi bu ta'sir karbonat angidrid kabi issiqxona gazlariga qaraganda hali ham kichik bo'lsada.

“Ushbu material bizning atmosferamizga zararli ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkinligi to'g'risida juda ko'p ilmiy dalillar mavjud, va endi olimlar sifatida bu ta'sirlar sodir bo'layotganini va ular qanchalik yomon ekanligini aniqlash bizning zimmamizda,” deydi Cziczo.

Ba'zi yechimlar bo'lishi mumkin, masalan, sun'iy yo'ldoshlarni yog'ochga o'xshash materiallardan qurish - garchi u qaytib kirganda baribir qora uglerod qurumi(kuyasi)ni chiqarib yuborishi mumkin bo'lsa ham - yoki ularning ko'p qismini yuqori balandlikdagi "qabriston orbitalariga" chiqarish (ishdan chiqarish).

“Biz biroz vaqt ajratib, biror narsa qilishdan oldin nima qilayotganimiz haqida o'ylab ko'rishimiz kerak,” deydi Ving. “Sun'iy yo'ldoshlarning bu portlashi (jadal o'sishi)... juda tez yuz bermoqda va biz uning oqibatlarini bilmaymiz.”
